name: finem-infrastructure-devops
description: Provision reproducible environments and operate the build, release, deployment and rollback path with visible infrastructure costs.

interface.longDescription:
Provision reproducible environments and operate the build, release, deployment and rollback path with visible infrastructure costs.

Covers: Infrastructure, Networking, CI, Release, Deployment, Rollback, Cost/FinOps, Configuration/environments.

Expected outputs: Infrastructure and network configuration; Environment and CI configuration; Release, deployment and rollback plans; Infrastructure cost assessment.

Original skills used through Engineering Core: pulumi:pulumi-best-practices, wshobson:hybrid-cloud-networking, addy:ci-cd-and-automation, gstack:ship, addy:git-workflow-and-versioning, wshobson:deployment-pipeline-design, wshobson:database-migration, addy:deprecation-and-migration, wshobson:cost-optimization, pulumi:pulumi-esc.

Optional specialist and framework packs: cloudflare, terraform, kubernetes, security-audit, finops, aws-containers. These are selected for the project when relevant; they are not all enabled by default.

Declared integrations: cloud-provider, context7, github, db-provider. These are integration recipes, not connected services; configure the corresponding tools and accounts separately.

Why the app shows one skill: this plugin exposes one entry skill which loads the relevant original specialists from Engineering Core on demand. The Skills count in the app is not the size of the shared upstream library.

Requires Engineering Core (finem-core). Tasks spanning multiple disciplines may also require the corresponding area plugins.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project for Infrastructure & DevOps and recommend the relevant original skills and framework packs.
Review Infrastructure & DevOps in this project and prioritize concrete improvements with verification steps.
